> Executive Gym (חדר כושר ניהולי) is an online management training program delivered via Zoom, designed for CEOs and business owners who want to sharpen their leadership and management skills. The concept mirrors a physical gym but for the mind — short, focused 15-20 minute 'workout' sessions, three times a week, covering a variety of management topics. The brand blends fitness culture with professional development, making executive education accessible, consistent, and time-efficient.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About חדר כושר ניהולי
Executive Gym (חדר כושר ניהולי) is an online management training program delivered via Zoom, designed for CEOs and business owners who want to sharpen their leadership and management skills. The concept mirrors a physical gym but for the mind — short, focused 15-20 minute 'workout' sessions, three times a week, covering a variety of management topics. The brand blends fitness culture with professional development, making executive education accessible, consistent, and time-efficient.

## Target Audience
- מנכ"לים ובעלי עסקים
- מנהלים בדרג ביניים
- מנהלי משאבי אנוש והדרכה

## Industry
הדרכה וניהול עסקי
